qualification.reason: This document is a formal Request for Quotations (RFQ) issued by NYS Office of General Services for an Aggregate Hardware Buy, containing scope, submission deadlines, evaluation criteria, and terms and conditions, clearly indicating a procurement opportunity.

quotes.quote: RFQ Title Aggregate Hardware Buy 23-01 RFQ Number 23-01

OGS is seeking competitive quotes from Contract holders of the OGS Group 73600 Award 22802 Information Technology Umbrella Contract – Manufacturer Based (Statewide) (“Manufacturer Umbrella Contract”) for the Lot(s) indicated below.
BASIS FOR AWARD Highest Total Financial Score meeting specified Technical Requirements and Mandatory Pass/Fail Requirements for each Standard Configuration and associated Required Products.
The purpose of RFQ 23-01 is to establish an award for each Configuration as set forth in Attachment A - Technical Response.

Quotes and pricing submitted in response to RFQ 23-01 must remain open and valid for at least 120 calendar days from the date that RFQ Submissions are due, unless the time for making an award is extended by mutual consent of OGS and the Contractor.

findings.title: Deadline for Contractor Questions and Comments
findings.fact: Questions and comments for the RFQ are only accepted up to the Attachment B due date and time noted in the document.
findings.business_implication: Missing the deadline for questions and comments means the bidder cannot seek clarification or request changes to the RFQ, potentially leading to misunderstandings or non-compliant bids.
findings.action_recommendation: Mark the Attachment B due date and time in calendars and ensure all questions and comments are submitted via email to OGS.sm.PS.AggregateBuy@ogs.ny.gov with the specified subject line before the deadline.

quotes.quote:
Attachment B – Contractor Questions and Comments: 
Questions and Comments for this RFQ will only be accepted up to the Attachment B - Contractor Questions and Comments 
due date and time noted above.

findings.title: Evaluation Process and Weighting
findings.fact: The evaluation process is described with relative weights: Technical Response is Pass/Fail, and Financial Response is 100% of the score. The financial score is based on lowest cost with points weighted as: Standard Configuration - 50 points, Required Products (Warranty/Services - 15 points, Components - 30 points, Peripherals - 5 points).
findings.business_implication: Since the financial response is the sole scoring criterion, the bidder's pricing strategy is critical. Even a technically compliant bid will lose if pricing is not competitive. The weighting indicates that the Standard Configuration price has the highest impact, followed by Components, Warranty/Services, and Peripherals.
findings.action_recommendation: Focus on offering the lowest possible pricing for the Standard Configuration and Required Products, especially Components, to maximize the financial score. Ensure technical compliance to pass the Pass/Fail stage.

quotes.quote:
EVALUATION PROCESS. 
 
The relative weights of each part of the Proposal are as follows:

Technical Response (Attachment A – Technical Response, Attachment D – Issue Escalation Plan, and 
Manufacturer Information Page): Pass/Fail    
   Financial Response : 100%  
Total Financial Score is based on lowest cost and the points are weighted as follows: 
• Standard Configuration - 50 points 
• Required Products  
o Warranty/Services - 15 points 
o Components - 30 points  
o Peripherals - 5 points  
 
The evaluation is a three-stage process set forth below:  
 
5.1.1 STAGE 1 ADMINISTRATIVE REVIEW 
 
The submitted Attachment A – Technical Response, Attachment D – Issue Escalation Plan, and the Manufacturer 
Information page (last page of this document) will be reviewed for completeness.  The addition or deletion of 
worksheets, columns, unlocking the document, rewriting formulas, or similar alterations to any document is 
prohibited. OGS reserves the right to reject any RFQ Submission or portion(s) thereof determined to have been 
altered/modified by the Contractor from the original format. Failure to provide fully completed documents may 
result in rejection of the RFQ Submission without further review.  
 
5.1.2 STAGE 2 TECHNICAL EVALUATION OF CONFIGURATION SUBMISSION 
 
Submitted Attachment A – Technical Response will be compared to Standard Configuration and Required 
Products requirements.  All proposed SKUs for proposed products offered in Attachment A – Technical Response 
must be on the Contractor’s approved Manufacturer Umbrella Contract price list. Any Configuration that contains 
a SKU that is not included on the Manufacturer’s Umbrella Contract price list may not proceed further in the 
evaluation process.   
 
5.1.3 STAGE 3 FINANCIAL EVALUATION 
 
Only Contractors whose Standard Configuration specifications and Required Products pass review, as determined 
by OGS, will proceed to the evaluation of Attachment C – Financial Response for those specific Configurations. 
For those Contractors who have been determined to have passed the Technical Evaluation, their Attachment A - 
Technical Response will be used to create the Attachment C – Financial Response and will be provided to the 
Contractor in order to complete and submit.  The proposed pricing on Attachment C – Financial Response will then 
be used in the Financial Evaluation.

findings.title: SKU Price List Requirement
findings.fact: All proposed SKUs must be on the Contractor's approved Manufacturer Umbrella Contract price list prior to the RFQ submission due date. OGS will prioritize contract modification requests related to this RFQ. Pricing on Attachment C must be equal to or better than the pricing on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract.
findings.business_implication: If any proposed SKU is not on the approved price list, the bid may be disqualified. Additionally, pricing must be at or below the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract price, which may limit profit margins. However, OGS will prioritize contract modification requests, offering an opportunity to add needed SKUs.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that all SKUs intended for the bid are on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract price list well before the submission deadline. If any SKUs are missing, submit a contract modification request promptly, indicating they are for RFQ 23-01. Ensure that pricing on Attachment C is at or below the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract pricing.

quotes.quote:
Section 6.   EVALUATION COMPONENTS 
 
All proposed SKUs for Products offered must be on the Contractor’s approved Manufacturer Umbrella Contract 
price list prior to the RFQ Submission due date for RFQ 23-01.   OGS will prioritize any Contract modification 
requests related to this RFQ 23-01, provided that the Contractor indicates in their Contract modification request 
that the Products are intended for this RFQ 23-01. Contractors are requested to limit such Contract modification 
requests to only Products needed to respond to this RFQ. All pricing offered on Attachment C - Financial Response 
must be equal to or better than the pricing offered for that SKU on the Contractor's Manufacturer Umbrella Contract.

findings.title: Required Products Designation
findings.fact: The RFP designates specific Products as Required Products for evaluation purposes.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must include all Required Products in their bid; failure to do so may result in rejection. These products are mandatory and will be evaluated, so their pricing and availability are crucial.
findings.action_recommendation: Carefully review Attachment A to identify all Required Products for each Configuration bid. Ensure that all Required Products are included in the bid and that pricing is competitive, as they contribute to the financial score.

quotes.quote: For evaluation purposes, specific Products have been designated as Required Products.

findings.title: Late RFQ Responses May Be Rejected
findings.fact: The RFQ states that late responses may be rejected, which could result in disqualification and loss of opportunity.
findings.business_implication: Submitting the RFQ response after the deadline will likely lead to rejection, eliminating any chance of winning the contract. The bidder bears all risk for timely delivery.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan to submit the RFQ response well before the deadline to account for any unforeseen delays. Use reliable delivery methods and consider pre-registering for building access if delivering in person. Double-check the submission time and date.

quotes.quote: Late RFQ responses may be rejected.

findings.title: Contractor Responsibility for RFQ Submission Accuracy
findings.fact: Contractors are responsible for the accuracy of their RFQ submissions, meaning any errors or omissions could lead to rejection or liability.
findings.business_implication: The bidder bears full responsibility for the accuracy of their RFQ submission. Any errors, omissions, or inaccuracies could result in disqualification of the bid or potential legal liability. This places a significant burden on the bidder to ensure every detail is correct before submission.
findings.action_recommendation: Implement a rigorous internal review process for the RFQ submission. This should include multiple levels of review by technical, legal, and commercial experts. Create a checklist to verify all required documents are included and accurate. Consider having a third-party review to catch any potential errors. Ensure all data is cross-checked against the original RFQ requirements and the manufacturer's price list.

quotes.quote: Contractors are responsible for the accuracy of their RFQ Submissions.
